knowledge.purpose: Rich long-form body content (Markdown or sanitized HTML) rendered with proper typographic vertical rhythm — the first-party equivalent of a typography/prose plugin, styled entirely from theme tokens
useCases: Article or blog post body bound to a CMS field
Documentation page section with headings, lists, code, and links
Long terms-of-service / policy copy that needs readable rhythm
antiPatterns: A single short line or label — use text.text
Untrusted third-party HTML expecting full passthrough — prose sanitizes to a conservative allowlist (no script/iframe/event handlers)
knowledge.implementation:
Further anti-patterns:
- Interactive form markup — prose strips form/input/button; use form.* blocks

Further use cases:
- Any multi-paragraph rich text where individual text blocks would be tedious

props.name: content
props.description: Markdown string (preferred) OR a raw HTML fragment. Markdown supports headings (#), lists, **bold**, *italic*, `code`, fenced code, > blockquote, links and images. HTML is sanitized to a conservative tag/attribute allowlist. Bindable to a data source.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Reading-column max width. Numbers → px; strings (e.g. '65ch', '720px') pass through. Defaults to a readable measure via the layout container token.
